x-enumDescriptions.EntryPointProductionFacility: Entry point from a hydrogen production facility (e.g. electrolyser) into the hydrogen network.
x-enumDescriptions.ExitPointEndConsumer: Exit point at which hydrogen is withdrawn from the hydrogen network for delivery to an end consumer.
x-enumDescriptions.StorageConnectionPoint: Connection point to a hydrogen storage facility.
x-enumDescriptions.TerminalConnectionPoint: Connection point to a hydrogen terminal facility.
x-enumDescriptions.InterconnectionPoint: Border crossing or interconnection point between hydrogen networks or market areas.
x-enumDescriptions.ClusterExchangePoint: Point used for the exchange or transport of hydrogen between clusters.
x-enumDescriptions.VirtualTradingPoint: Virtual tradingpoint at which hydrogen quantities can be transferred virtually between balancing groups.
